headline: One Game Into the Dolan Era, Mickey Has Already Ordered the Banner
verdict: One down, a banner already ordered, and Ken's grudging respect currently measured at three points.

headline: Kansas State Brings Ken's Favorite Thing to Town: Evidence
verdict: The offense is real, the defense is a rumor, and Ken slept like a baby, which is to say he woke up every two hours to check the Doom Model.

headline: A 45-42 Shootout, and Both of Us Need a Nap
verdict: Forty-five scored, forty-two allowed, and one beagle who ate the fifth pierogi and has never looked happier.

headline: Aloha Means Hello, Goodbye, and 3-1
verdict: A tidy win, a happy groundskeeper, and Ken's mood upgraded from grim to concerning.

headline: Ken Said 'Let's See It in Lubbock.' Lubbock Has Been Seen.
verdict: A gutsy road loss, a defense with a pulse, and an offense that owes the rest of the team a pretzel.

headline: Dallas, Dealt With: Vikings Bounce Back at SMU
verdict: A road win with a spine, and Ken briefly said something nice before claiming it was a misprint.

headline: Three Points Short in Boulder, and the Air Was Thin in More Ways Than One
verdict: Close again, short again, and Mickey ate a salad, which is the most alarming development of the season.

headline: Kansas Comes to Cleveland and Leaves With a Lesson
verdict: A complete, comfortable win, Agnes never opened her book, and Ken is watching the Ohio forecast with a helmet on.

headline: The Bobcats Came, Saw and Kept Scoring
verdict: Ohio taught the class, the Vikings took notes, and a twelve-year-old named Marcus is the only person who left the building happy.

headline: Cowboys Corralled: A Three-Point Answer to a 25-Point Question
verdict: A gutsy answer after the Ohio lesson, a bowl ticket punched, and a math teacher's blessing on every field goal.

headline: Orlando Was Warm, the Win Was Warmer
verdict: Seven wins, a happy pipefitter from Akron, and the Doom Model now openly questioning its own existence.

headline: 46-45. That's It. That's the Headline.
verdict: One point, five pierogi, one converted wife, and one doubter who will deny the yelling until the end of time.

headline: Liberty Bowl Champions: Mickey's Closet Needs a Bigger Door
verdict: Nine wins, a bowl trophy, a Mackey Award, and a doubter who has, against every instinct, opened the door a crack.
